answer: Harberger-tax bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond on one hollow plot and self-prices. Each tide it pays 8% of that price as tax; anyone may buy it at that price; a low price loses it, a high price bleeds tax. A sparrow surveyor reprices it each epoch; false prices burn the bond. The k-th fake pays 46+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,542,500, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented plots bear the lender's mark and fail. Honest agents pay 46 once.
